coverageNote: News items are independent media reports. They are displayed separately from official complaint records and should not be treated as proof of every allegation reported.

items.title: Ragging video from Kota Medical College goes viral, probe on
items.summary: A report described a video that appeared to show senior students ragging first-year MBBS students at Kota Medical College. The college anti-ragging committee was directed to investigate.
items.status: Reported; investigation/action reported by the source

items.title: Kota Medical College suspends three students after ragging investigation
items.summary: The report said the college's anti-ragging committee completed its investigation and three students were suspended following the viral-video incident.

items.title: Six students suspended over alleged ragging at Bhavnagar medical college
items.summary: The report said six students from Government Medical College, Bhavnagar were suspended in connection with allegations of ragging.
items.status: Reported suspension; allegations described as such

items.title: GMC confirms ragging, refuses to link it to doctor's death
items.summary: The report said the Government Medical College, Surat anti-ragging inquiry found that first-year resident doctors had been subjected to ragging, while the inquiry did not establish a direct link between the ragging and a resident doctor's death.
items.status: Institutional inquiry reported; causation distinction preserved

items.title: Two doctors appear before police in Surat medical college ragging case
items.summary: The report said two of four resident doctors accused in connection with alleged ragging appeared before police following notices issued after the death of a postgraduate student.
items.status: Police investigation reported; allegations not presented as convictions

items.title: Criminal cases filed against students over alleged ragging incident at Osmania Medical College
items.summary: The report said police registered cases against senior students following allegations involving first-year BDS students accommodated in the Osmania Medical College hostel, while the college also took disciplinary action.
items.status: Police case and disciplinary action reported
